entries.name: japan_tokyo_prefecture_2015
entries.source: Tokyo 2015 prefectural IO candidate copied from the confirmed-candidates collection
entries.selection: Inspect the old .xls sheet and select the 107-sector transaction block only after confirming row/column codes and total rows/columns.
entries.result: The sheet is 123x141, with 107 sector row codes and 138 populated value columns. The candidate 107x107 block has a separate intermediate-total column and additional final-demand/value-added rows. The file was used to verify that the extraction boundary remains explicit; no automatic x or Z selection was performed.

entries.name: united_kingdom_2023
entries.selection: Use the explicitly labelled IOT, A, and Leontief blocks; omit aggregate final-demand totals when component columns are retained.
entries.result: Dense and iterative routes, accounting, and reference comparisons were exercised; A was comparable, while the supplied Leontief reference contained missing/non-numeric values and was reported locally as invalid.

entries.name: taiwan_2023

entries.name: korea_2023

entries.result: Domestic accounting, imported-input adjustment, and A/L reference paths were exercised.

entries.result: The supplied CSV and XLSX values were identical for the 15-sector matrix.

entries.name: united_states_bea_2002_detail
entries.source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis 2002 Benchmark Input-Output Accounts
entries.selection: Read the supplied field-layout documentation and parse the fixed-width row, column, value records before constructing a SUT or SIOT.
entries.result: The package contains 4,773-line Make, 57,131-line Use, and 185,311-line Direct Requirements files including headers. The fixed-width records and 2002 year fields were verified. The official note that detail may differ from totals due to rounding was retained as a validation constraint.

entries.name: united_states_bls_2035
entries.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Employment Projections Program
entries.selection: Use the documented 176-sector Make, 177x177 Use, 176x132 detailed FD, 176x11 aggregate FD, and separate output files. Remove terminal row/column only in caller-controlled extraction.
entries.result: The documented Use terminal row is value added and terminal column is final demand. After explicit extraction and transposing the file's industry-by-commodity Make to SUTSystem's product-by-industry convention, all four SUT balances passed with absolute and rounding tolerance 0.05 million chained 2017 dollars.

entries.result: The long-form axes and semantic dimensions were inspected; automatic extraction is outside the package.
